verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only the opposite direction: external MCP-capable agents such as Claude and Cursor connect to Airbyte's data through Airbyte's own MCP servers. Nothing shows Airbyte acting as an MCP client that can register external MCP servers and use their tools. Server-side MCP evidence belongs to a different story and does not transfer, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
